notes.title: Halloween Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Presenting a free content update:[/h1]

[list]
[*] 3 new levels based on the Autumn season
[*] 3 new boss fights
[*] 4 New weapons
[*] New enemy types
[*] New Puzzles
[*] New character skins
[*] Added achievements
[/list]
[h1]
Also fixed bugs:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Reworked settings menu
[*] Added UI sounds
[*] Added back button support for UI
[*] Fixed bomb-throwing bug where I won't throw correctly while running in the opposite direction
[*] Added an invisible wall on the train level so players wouldn't fall when running toward the front of the train
[/list]

notes.title: Summer Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h3]Santa and Mrs. Claus just wanted a short, relaxing vacation under the summer sun. But shadows are never far away. When new troubles emerge, the duo, as always, handles them with serious firepower.[/h3]

[h3]Presenting a free content update:[/h3]

[list]
[*] 3 new levels
[*] 3 new boss fights
[*] New weapons
[*] New enemy types
[*] Puzzles
[*] New character skins
[*] Added Polish and Turkish language support
[/list]

[h3]Also fixed bugs:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed situation where only one player dies but the level restarts
[*] Fixed enemy spawning near players at checkpoints
[*] Fixed Frost King boss damaging only player 1
[*] Fixed Blob Snowman toxic puddles damaging only player 1
[*] Fixed camera returning to player 1's dead body after player 2 dies
[*] Fixed bug where player is controllable but in a dead animation state
[*] Changed minigun sound
[*] Changed sniper gun behavior
[*] Fixed various other bugs
[/list]

[h3]Have a great summer, and stay tuned for the next updates![/h3]

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 13
notes.content: - Thanks to steam user lambic74, it has come to my attention that the previous bug fix didn't solve the issue of two controllers for all players. Therefore, I have reworked how the game detects the type of controller connected. Now, players should not encounter any problems when playing with two gamepads.
